title: A registered committed-input run from an Engram-project session ends with no verification record and no stated reason (EO trial w-ec0406b4930b)
outcome: A registered, eligible, passing committed-input launcher run in a claim's named source root either delivers its verification record to that claim's store, or the agent is told plainly why no record was produced. A run never ends silently with no record and no reason.
acceptance: A second registered launcher run in a worktree that the same session re-named for a new claim, while an earlier claim's named-root entry for that exact root is still retained, binds to the current claim and delivers its verification record; or the ambiguity is refused or reported at registration with a reason naming both generations and works, and the launcher prints it. A run never ends silently unbound.
A regression test covers re-naming one root for a second claim in the same session and store, for both the binding and the reported reason. Existing single-entry registration behavior is unchanged.

completion.summary: Ambiguous named-root registrations, where one root has two retained entries, are now refused with a bounded reason naming both generations and works. The launcher prints that reason, so a run never ends silently unbound. Regression tests cover the re-name case for binding and reason; single-entry behavior is unchanged.
